title: alpha-AOS project pack catalog
description: Closed-world contract for a catalog/packs/*.yaml file. The declarations are the single authority for which capability packs a repository qualifies for; code loads and evaluates them but never restates them. Namespaced x-* extensions are split out before validation, so every object described here is exhaustive.

factId.description: A fact declared by catalog/facts.yaml, referenced by a predicate leaf. A leaf naming an undeclared fact is refused at load, never treated as false.

literalList.description: Inline literals a detector matches directly. The evaluator synthesizes the explaining fact id from the operator and the matched literal, so these are not fact ids and are not subject to the undeclared-fact refusal.

leafList.description: The items of a deepest-level `all` / `any`: fact ids only. The recursion stops here, which is what bounds validation cost by the schema rather than by the document.

evidenceNode4.description: Nesting level 4 — the deepest a predicate may go. Its `all` / `any` items are fact ids only; there is no level 5.

evidenceNode3.description: Nesting level 3. Its `all` / `any` items are a fact id or a level-4 node.

evidenceNode2.description: Nesting level 2. Its `all` / `any` items are a fact id or a level-3 node.

evidenceNode1.description: A pack's predicate root. Exactly one of the five operators the declared packs already use; `all` and `any` items may nest, and the four explicit levels below are declared rather than a self-referencing $ref cycle, because an unbounded cycle would let a hostile document set the validation cost.

all.description: Every named fact must be detected.

any.description: At least one named fact must be detected.

anyFiles.description: At least one of these paths, relative to the canonical root, must exist.

anyDependencies.description: At least one of these package names must be declared by a manifest at the canonical root.

manifestOptIn.description: The named project-manifest key must opt this pack in.

^x-[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$.description: A namespaced extension. Preserved verbatim and inert; nothing in alpha-AOS reads it. One rule governs every nested declared object in this repository's catalog contracts — a fact item and a pack item alike accept `x-` namespaced keys and refuse every other undeclared key — so the identical block appears in schemas/fact-vocabulary.schema.json and the two must be edited together.

id.description: Stable pack identifier, referenced by receipts and approved plans.

skills.description: ECC skill ids this pack supplies. An empty array declares a pack that supplies no skill.

lifecycle.description: Declared and carried by this phase; materialization acts on it in a later phase.

selectionPolicy.description: How this pack composes with a native engine covering the same ground.
